_comment: Page bodies shared by more than one game's object editor. `weap_common` holds the weapon subrecords Fallout: New Vegas, Fallout 3, Skyrim and Fallout 4 all carry — measured: CRDT, DNAM, EAMT, INAM, NNAM are the only five shared by all four, out of 107 across them. A game's WEAP category says "extends": "weap_common" and lists its own sections; a section title it shares replaces the template's rather than appearing twice.
